title: Ben Enwonwu's birth chart
metaDescription: Ben Enwonwu's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 21.4° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mercury, Mars and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 21.4° Cancer. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the classical scheme — a water sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 12.1° Cancer; Venus stands at 6.3° Gemini; Mars stands at 17.0° Cancer. The tradition reads a mind that absorbs before it argues from Mercury, taste led by wit and proportion from Venus, drive that moves on certainty and current from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Uranus and Pluto hold the closest angle here — a trine, 0.5° wide. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required. Behind it, the Sun sextile Saturn at 1.1°, and Mars sextile Jupiter at 1.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Neptune stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Three planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Moon in Scorpio at 18.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Cancer at 17.0° is in fall; Jupiter in Virgo at 15.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 6, earth 2, air 1, fire 1; modalities cardinal 4, mutable 4, fixed 2. Mercury and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.7° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 18.9°.
